newsitem.title: INDIA: India copper rises, tin recovers, aluminium steady.
newsitem.headline: India copper rises, tin recovers, aluminium steady.

text.p: Copper prices lifted further while tin bounced back from a lower level on Wednesday, dealers said.
Other metals were largely quiet expect for zinc, which showed signs of an uptrend, they said.

Ready copper rose by 100 rupees to 12,200 per quintal on thin supplies and fresh speculative buying. It had risen by 200 rupees on Tuesday. Tin recovered lost ground, rising by 200 rupees to 34,200 per quintal on fresh physical support.

Zinc rose by 50 rupees to 6,425 per quintal on the back of a price hike announced by the Hindustan Zinc Ltd. Lead was quiet at 4,600 rupees per quintal. Nickel was steady at Rs 36,500 per quintal. It had lost 300 rupees on Tuesday.
Aluminium was quiet at 7,225 per quintal.
